key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings—150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen—provide a process-development reference for this coating–substrate system.
method: Two-level full factorial design with 24 experimental runs.
ANOVA quantified spray-parameter contributions to coating properties.
Pareto charts assessed interactions among spray parameters.
evidence_signal: Coating responses were measured for each experimental run, but the abstract reports no numerical property values or uncertainty estimates.
watch_item: Validate these settings on the intended equipment and application before treating them as transferable production conditions.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
